visa = a stamp or document that allows you to enter a country
border = the line between two countries
customs = the place at an airport or border where bags are checked
security check = when staff search you and your bags before a flight
passport control = the place where an officer checks your passport
terminal = a large building at an airport for passengers
departure lounge = the waiting area after security, before you board
baggage reclaim = the place where you collect suitcases after a flight
hand luggage = a small bag you take into the cabin
lost luggage = bags that the airline cannot find
runway = the long strip where planes take off and land
direct flight = a flight that does not stop in another city
stopover = a short stay in a city between two flights
cabin crew = the staff who look after passengers on a plane
seat belt = a belt that holds you in your seat
turbulence = sudden movement of a plane caused by air
delayed = happening later than planned
railway station = a building where trains stop for passengers
bus station = a building where coaches and buses start and finish
bus stop = a place at the side of the road where a bus stops
